title: What fish prefer (D101): the bait keywords, the weather words, and how much a preference counts

factor.description: A fish's weight in a table is multiplied by this once for each of its preferences the moment meets: time of day, weather, season, bait, moon.

baits.description: The kinds of bait. A bait item names one (its `bait`); a fish lists those it prefers.

weatherWords.description: Words for the weather, read off its levels (src/engine/weather.js). Every condition given must hold. `tag` and `without` look at the weather cell's tags in content/weather/, for what the levels can't tell: fog, snow.

moonWords.description: Words for the moon (D168), read off src/engine/moon.js. Every condition given must hold. `lit`: the part of the moon's disc lit, 0 at new moon, 1 at full, day or night. `light`: the moonlight on the water, 0 to 1 (the part lit, times how high the moon is, under the clouds; 0 by day and in the twilight). `night`: only when the sun is far enough down for the moon's light to count (rules/moon.json, `dark`).
